اقتتلتن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَتَلْتُنَّ (iqtataltunna) /iq.ta.tal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# اُقْتُتِلْتُنَّ (uqtutiltunna) /uq.tu.til.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اُقْتُتِلَ (uqtutila)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
